title: DDGS 2.0.1
release_notes: The Assistant is here: give it a mission and it searches the web, fetches pages, saves files, downloads videos and images, and schedules crawls for you, asking once before anything is written. 50 credits a day with a receipt on every reply; Premium raises it to 500 and removes ads. Expandable reasoning, a live model catalog, and this release fixes the Assistant screen scrolling on phones.
